title: The Blue Ledger
premise: A getaway driver who works alone must join a crew to steal a crime boss's bribe ledger — and decide whether the truth inside it is worth more than her brother's debt.
logline: In a drowning port city, the only way to pay a debt is to steal the book it is written in.
themes: Loyalty you are paid for versus loyalty you choose
Truth has a price, and someone else usually pays it
tone: Rain-noir with dry humour; grounded violence; warm crew banter against a cold city.

characters.name: Ines Rook
characters.want: Clear her brother Mika's debt to Crane.
characters.need: Let other people carry part of the weight.
characters.flaw: Never asks for help; leaves before she can be left.
characters.arc: From lone driver who sleeps in her car to a woman who chooses a crew — and chooses what the ledger is for.
characters.voice: Clipped, dry, car metaphors, never says please.

characters.name: Teodor Mallin
characters.want: One last clean score to buy his sister's boat.
characters.arc: From "I need a driver, not a partner" to handing the dial to Ines and taking the wheel.
characters.voice: Slow, old-world courtesy, calls everyone "friend", talks about people as if they were locks.

characters.name: Pell Asare
characters.want: Expose Crane's ledger to the whole city.
characters.need: Learn that people, not causes, pay for the truth.
characters.flaw: Treats people as means to a cause.
characters.arc: From zealot to someone who weighs who gets hurt — and either forgives Ines or learns to.
characters.voice: Fast, jargon, nervous jokes, sentences that trip over each other.

characters.name: Augustin Crane
characters.want: Keep the port, keep the book, keep everyone wearing blue.
characters.need: To be needed rather than feared (he never learns it).
characters.arc: A flat arc tested to breaking: his certainty cracks when Ines names her own price.
characters.voice: Warm, patient, uses first names, never raises his voice.

characters.name: Bram Hollis
characters.want: Collect on time and go home to his pigeons.

characters.name: Odile Marrow
characters.want: Get her daughter out of Harrowgate.
characters.arc: From Crane's clerk to the witness who ends him (if trusted).

characters.name: Mika Rook
characters.want: Be forgiven without having to ask.

teo_after__start.speaker: Teo
teo_after__start.text: The dial turned for you like it turned for me, twenty years ago.

teo_after__wheel.speaker: Ines
teo_after__wheel.text: You drove like it was tomorrow.

teo_heist__hot.speaker: Teo
teo_heist__hot.text: Crane's men are doubled tonight. Someone embarrassed them in the yards.

teo_heist__calm.speaker: Teo
teo_heist__calm.text: Ledger first, then the harbor mouth. I keep the engine warm.

teo_brief__start.speaker: Teo
teo_brief__start.text: Lanterns on the water at nine. Every guard will be watching the sky.

teo_brief__plan_risk.speaker: Teo
teo_brief__plan_risk.text: Your clerk sounded frightened on the phone. Frightened people make calls.

teo_brief__plan_door.speaker: Teo
teo_brief__plan_door.text: Your clerk says the service door opens at the second firework. A good friend to have.

teo_brief__hands.speaker: Teo
teo_brief__hands.text: They shake for coffee. For steel, never. You take the dial tonight. I will drive.

teo_plans__start.speaker: Teo
teo_plans__start.text: Good paper. Steel door, old dial, newer alarm. The alarm is not from my century.

teo_plans__pell.speaker: Teo
teo_plans__pell.text: A kid at the Saltline Relay talks to machines. Pell. Be gentle.

teo_plans__parked.speaker: Teo
teo_plans__parked.text: You are always parked. It is not the same thing.

teo_wait__start.speaker: Teo
teo_wait__start.text: Yards first, then the blueprints. The vault will not mail us its floor plan.

teo_pitch__start.speaker: Teo
teo_pitch__start.text: Still sleeping in the car, friend? The seats do not recline that far.

teo_pitch__reply.speaker: Ines
teo_pitch__reply.text: They recline exactly as far as I need.

choices.text: Mika's debt is in that book.

teo_pitch__pitch.speaker: Teo
teo_pitch__pitch.text: Customs House vault. Crane keeps a ledger there. Every bribe in Harrowgate, in his own hand.

teo_pitch__family.speaker: Teo
teo_pitch__family.text: Then we tear out his page together. Scout the Crane Yards first.

teo_pitch__money.speaker: Teo
teo_pitch__money.text: A third, and the car stays yours. Scout the Crane Yards first.

teo_pitch__refuse.speaker: Teo
teo_pitch__refuse.text: Then drive me past the yards tomorrow. Just look. Looking is free.

teo__idle.speaker: Teodor Mallin
teo__idle.text: Patience opens more doors than dynamite, friend.

pell_heist__doubt.speaker: Pell
pell_heist__doubt.text: Cameras die in six minutes. And after, we are still arguing about that ledger.

pell_heist__sure.speaker: Pell
pell_heist__sure.text: Cameras die in six minutes. Then the whole city gets a bedtime story.

pell_done__start.speaker: Pell
pell_done__start.text: Grid's mine. Customs House cameras go dark for six minutes. Six. Not seven.

pell_wait__start.speaker: Pell
pell_wait__start.text: Three chips. The tower eats the rest when it rains.

pell_meet__start.speaker: Pell
pell_meet__start.text: You're the driver? Teo said you'd be taller. Or nicer.

choices.text: Deal. The whole city reads it.
We see what it's worth first.

pell_meet__ask.speaker: Pell
pell_meet__ask.text: I'll kill the alarm. One condition. The ledger goes public, all of it, the same night.

pell_meet__leak.speaker: Pell
pell_meet__leak.text: Great. Okay. Three relay chips, scattered round the tower. Bring them and I own the grid.

pell_meet__sale.speaker: Pell
pell_meet__sale.text: Wow. Okay. Still need three relay chips. We can argue on the way down.

pell__idle.speaker: Pell Asare
pell__idle.text: Do not touch the blue wire. Or the other blue wire.

crane_offer__start.speaker: Crane
crane_offer__start.text: Ines. Sit. You have my book, and I have your brother's future. Let's be adults.

crane_offer__mika.speaker: Crane
crane_offer__mika.text: Mika's debt, gone. Tonight. Hand me the ledger and he sleeps easy.

crane_offer__price.speaker: Crane
crane_offer__price.text: You came for money. I have more of it than the ledger does. Name a number.

crane_offer__paid_line.speaker: Crane
crane_offer__paid_line.text: You paid Bram on time. You are a person who pays. I respect that.

choices.text: Pell's right. Everyone reads it tonight.

crane_offer__leak.speaker: Crane
crane_offer__leak.text: Then you sold yourself for a headline. I hope it keeps you warm.

crane_offer__leak_reply.speaker: Ines
crane_offer__leak_reply.text: It won't. That's fine. I've got a car.

crane_offer__sell.speaker: Crane
crane_offer__sell.text: Sensible. The book, please. Mika's page is already burning.

crane_offer__sell_broken.speaker: Ines
crane_offer__sell_broken.text: Pell is going to hate me. Add it to the list.

crane_offer__sell_quiet.speaker: Ines
crane_offer__sell_quiet.text: Pleasure doing business. Never call me.

crane_offer__witness.speaker: Crane
crane_offer__witness.text: A clerk? Odile Marrow? She stamps parcels.

crane_offer__witness_reply.speaker: Ines
crane_offer__witness_reply.text: She stamped every one of yours. She remembers.

crane__idle.speaker: Augustin Crane
crane__idle.text: Everyone in Harrowgate works for me. Most of them just don't know it yet.

bram_beaten__start.speaker: Bram
bram_beaten__start.text: You've made this loud, Rook. Loud travels uphill.

bram_brawl__start.speaker: Bram
bram_brawl__start.text: Five. Six. They're still standing, Rook.

bram_paid__start.speaker: Bram
bram_paid__start.text: Four thousand, exact. Mister Crane will hear that you pay your debts.

bram_wait__start.speaker: Bram
bram_wait__start.text: The yard office closes when I say. Bring the bundles.

bram_corner__start.speaker: Bram
bram_corner__start.text: Ines Rook. Your brother owes Mister Crane four thousand. I'm told to count to ten.

choices.text: Take the heist advance. All of it.

bram_corner__pay.speaker: Bram
bram_corner__pay.text: Sensible. Bring both cash bundles to the yard office.

bram__idle.speaker: Bram Hollis
bram__idle.text: I count, Rook. That's all I do. I count.

odile_pass__warm.speaker: Odile
odile_pass__warm.text: Visitor pass and the night rota. Second firework, service door. Be careful.

odile_pass__cold.speaker: Odile
odile_pass__cold.text: Your pass. Don't come to my window again.

odile_wait__start.speaker: Odile
odile_wait__start.text: Walk the building once. Count the doors. Then come back to my window.

odile_meet__start.speaker: Odile
odile_meet__start.text: You're standing in the customs line without a parcel. People notice that.

odile_meet__stamp.speaker: Ines
odile_meet__stamp.text: Crane owns you. I can tell by how you hold the stamp.

choices.text: The service door. Or Crane hears you talked.
The service door. And two seats out of town.

odile_meet__offer.speaker: Odile
odile_meet__offer.text: He owns my daughter's papers. What do you want from me?

odile_meet__threat.speaker: Odile
odile_meet__threat.text: Then I'll do it. And I'll hate you quietly, which is how I do everything.

odile_meet__trust.speaker: Odile
odile_meet__trust.text: Nobody has offered me a seat before. The door opens at the second firework.

odile__idle.speaker: Odile Marrow
odile__idle.text: Window closed. Come back with a form.

mika_epilogue__leak.speaker: Mika
mika_epilogue__leak.text: The ledger's on every screen in Harrowgate. They're arresting harbor police. Harbor police!

mika_epilogue__sale.speaker: Mika
mika_epilogue__sale.text: Bram came by. He tore up my marker and apologised for the door. Who apologises?

mika_epilogue__witness_line.speaker: Mika
mika_epilogue__witness_line.text: Odile Marrow testified for six hours. The papers call her the Stamp.

mika_epilogue__thanks.speaker: Mika
mika_epilogue__thanks.text: You did all that for me. You could have just asked me to stop.

mika_epilogue__money.speaker: Mika
mika_epilogue__money.text: Teo says you took the job for the cut. I don't believe him.

choices.text: I did ask. You didn't stop.

mika__idle.speaker: Mika Rook
mika__idle.text: I'm not gambling. I'm drawing. Look, it's you.

quests.title: Cold Engine
quests.description: Teo pitches the Customs House job. Scout the yards and steal the vault blueprints.

quests.title: Ghost in the Wire
quests.description: Recruit Pell, who wants the ledger made public. Gather relay chips to own the grid.

quests.title: Collectors
quests.description: Crane's enforcer comes for Mika's debt. Pay him off or fight.

quests.title: The Hard Way
quests.description: Put Bram's crew on the ground.

quests.title: The Inside Man
quests.description: Turn Crane's customs clerk: threaten her or offer her a way out.

objectives.text: Collect the visitor pass from Odile

quests.title: Lantern Regatta
quests.description: Fireworks at nine. Steal the ledger and get out through the harbor mouth.

objectives.text: Crack the vault and take the ledger

quests.title: What the Ledger Weighs
quests.description: Crane summons Ines to his tower. Leak the ledger, sell it, or hand it to a witness.

quests.title: Low Tide
quests.description: Epilogue on Kettle Street: Mika, the morning after.

ending.title: Low Tide
ending.text: The tide goes out on Harrowgate, and for once the Rooks are not wearing blue.

acts.title: Act I — Wearing Blue
acts.purpose: Setup: the debt, the job, the crew. Ends when Ines commits to a crew (ghost_wire + collectors).

acts.title: Act II — The Inside
acts.purpose: Confrontation: the debt is handled one way or another (foldback), the crew needs a way in.

acts.title: Act III — Lanterns
acts.purpose: Climax and resolution: the heist, the decision, the cost.

motive_family.desc: Ines took the job for Mika

motive_money.desc: Ines took the job for the money

world.setting: Harrowgate, a tidal port of container cranes, flooded lower streets and neon fish markets, run by one shipping magnate.
facts: Harrowgate floods at spring tide; the lower districts live on stilts and gangways.
Augustin Crane owns the container terminal, the tug fleet and three judges.
Debt markers are written on blue paper; owing Crane is called "wearing blue".
The Lantern Regatta: once a year every boat carries a paper lantern; fireworks start at nine.
The Customs House vault predates electricity; its dial was made by Teo's old teacher.

locations.name: Kettle Street
locations.desc: Noodle stalls under tarps, steam and rain.
hooks: Ines's car parked under a broken awning, blanket on the back seat
Blue debt markers pinned to a stall's "wall of shame"
A noodle stall with two stools, one always kept for Teo

locations.name: Crane Yards
locations.desc: Container stacks, sodium lights, a yard office on stilts.
hooks: Containers stencilled with Crane's heron logo
A guard rota chalked on a whiteboard
Tyre marks where the last debtor tried to drive away

locations.name: Saltline Relay
locations.desc: A rusting radio mast Pell has turned into a home.
hooks: Pell's hand-painted sign: "nothing here works (on purpose)"
Relay chips glinting in puddles below the mast

locations.name: Customs House
locations.desc: A grand old customs hall, half archive, half fortress.
hooks: Parcels stamped twice: once by customs, once by Crane
Odile's window with a child's drawing taped inside
Service door with fresh oil on its hinges

locations.name: Harbor Mouth
locations.desc: Where the lantern boats leave the harbor; the escape route.
hooks: A drawbridge operator asleep in his booth

locations.name: Crane Tower
locations.desc: Glass office above the terminal; Crane's view of everything he owns.
hooks: A heron sculpture made of melted debt-marker pins
Floor-to-ceiling window overlooking the flooded districts
